    AI Overview
    The final round of the 2026 Masters is on TV today, Sunday, April 12, on CBS from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET. Early coverage is available on streaming services, with Paramount+ streaming from noon to 2 p.m. ET, and featured groups coverage starting as early as 9:20 a.m. ET. 
    Sunday, April 12 TV Schedule (All times ET) 
    • Early Coverage: Noon – 2 p.m. (Paramount+)
    • Main Broadcast: 2 p.m. – 7 p.m. (CBS)
    • Final Round Tee Times: Players begin teeing off at approximately 9:30 a.m. ET 
    Sunday Streaming & Live Coverage 
    • Featured Groups: 9:20 a.m. – 7 p.m. (Masters.com, Masters App, Paramount+, ESPN App)
    • Amen Corner: 11:15 a.m. – 6 p.m. (Masters.com, Masters App, Paramount+)
    • Holes 15 & 16: 12:05 p.m. – 6:30 p.m. (Masters.com, Masters App, Paramount+) 
    The final pairing of Rory McIlroy and Cameron Young tees off at 2:25 p.m. ET.
